name: Balancer V2 composable stable pool rounding
summary: The Stable Pool exact-out path rounded the calculated input amount down instead of up. In low-liquidity, rate-scaled Composable Stable Pools, repeated crafted swaps amplified that error enough to manipulate the invariant, mint underpriced BPT, and extract reserves.
notes: The direct osETH/WETH Composable Stable Pool runtime containing the rounding defect was installed by this CREATE2 deployment.
The direct wstETH/WETH Composable Stable Pool runtime containing the rounding defect was installed by this CREATE2 deployment.

Balancer's official post-mortem reports $121.1 million in gross losses across Balancer-deployed pools on Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, Optimism, and Polygon. The structured components reproduce $70.654 million removed from the two Ethereum pools used by the code-age anchor and provide an onchain cross-check. Recovery and protected-at-risk funds are tracked separately from gross exploit loss.
Not the knot: sibling instance of the same template and failure; target-1 carries the latest age reset and supplies the incident's single observation.
